data: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.
Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.
While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.
Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.
Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.
Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.
Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.
Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.
Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.
Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.
Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.
Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.
Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.
Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.
When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.
Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist.
Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.
Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.
Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.
Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.
Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.
Provides move speed and fire rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.
When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.
Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.
Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage.
Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.
Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced.
Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.
When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.
When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.
Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.
Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.
Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus.
Targets can only be hit once per multishot.
Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.
Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits.
Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced.
to give health to friendly Heroes.
Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.
Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
+2m Radius and +18.0 DPS with improved Spirit scaling
Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun.
If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s
Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime.
Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
+25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime
Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.
Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets.
Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed and silenced .
Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging.
While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.
+2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling
Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.
On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s
Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use.
Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.
Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun.
Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.
Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus.
When you jump out, deal spirit damage, slow, and knockup.
Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.
+12.0 Bleed DPS with increased Spirit scaling
Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.
Bounces 1 times and improves Spirit Scaling
Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
+7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling
Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal spirit damage to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.
-32% Move Speed and Fire Rate for 4.0s
Applies damage over time to enemies nearby.
Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.
Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health.
Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.
Bullets also build up Lethal Venom
Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area.
Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.
+1.0s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.
Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.
Silences enemies for 2s if close range
Active: Accentuate your senses, revealing a trail that leads to nearby heroes.
Isolated heroes leave a trail as they move, and emit their heartbeat from afar.
You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes, and when isolated heroes die nearby you gain permanent weapon damage.
+3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina
Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage.
On Wall Stun: Your next heavy melee is blessed
Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself.
The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow
Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow.
After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.
While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6.0 Spirit Damage per Bullet
Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.
Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage.
Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.
The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.
Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit
Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback.
Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.
Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities.
When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.
-1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling
+80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s

Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.
Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
